title: Indian quick grocery delivery startup Zepto files for an India IPO, planning to raise ~$836M by selling new shares; Zepto was valued at $7B in its last round (Rajesh Mascarenhas/Bloomberg)
summary: Rajesh Mascarenhas / Bloomberg: Indian quick grocery delivery startup Zepto files for an India IPO, planning to raise ~$836M by selling new shares; Zepto was valued at $7B in its last round — Rapid-commerce firm Zepto Ltd. has filed an updated draft prospectus for an initial public offering, marking a key step toward …
